;; Honor MagicOS hwfactoryinterface 条件 SELinux 绑定（兼容 HIDL @1.1 与 AIDL 服务）

;; @when-any-declared hal_hwfactoryinterface hal_factoryinterface
;; @ensure-type hal_hwfactoryinterface_default hal_hwfactoryinterface_default_exec hal_hwfactoryinterface_service
(typeattributeset domain (hal_hwfactoryinterface_default))
(typeattributeset halserverdomain (hal_hwfactoryinterface_default))
(typeattributeset hal_hwfactoryinterface (hal_hwfactoryinterface_default))
(typeattributeset hal_hwfactoryinterface_server (hal_hwfactoryinterface_default))

(typeattributeset hal_service_type (hal_hwfactoryinterface_service))
(typeattributeset vendor_service (hal_hwfactoryinterface_service))

(allow init_{{vers}} hal_hwfactoryinterface_default_exec (file (read getattr map execute open)))
(allow init_{{vers}} hal_hwfactoryinterface_default (process (transition siginh rlimitinh)))

(allow hal_hwfactoryinterface_default hal_hwfactoryinterface_default_exec (file (read getattr map execute open entrypoint)))
(allow hal_hwfactoryinterface_client hal_hwfactoryinterface_server (binder (call transfer)))
(allow hal_hwfactoryinterface_server hal_hwfactoryinterface_client (binder (transfer)))
(allow hal_hwfactoryinterface_client hal_hwfactoryinterface_server (fd (use)))

;; @when-file bin/hw/vendor.honor.hardware.hwfactoryinterface@1.1-service

(allow hal_hwfactoryinterface_client hal_hwfactoryinterface_hwservice (hwservice_manager (find)))
(allow hal_hwfactoryinterface_client hal_hwfactoryinterface_default (binder (call transfer)))
(allow hal_hwfactoryinterface_default hal_hwfactoryinterface_client (binder (call transfer)))
(allow hal_factoryinterface_client hal_hwfactoryinterface_hwservice (hwservice_manager (find)))
(allow hal_factoryinterface_client hal_hwfactoryinterface_default (binder (call transfer)))
(allow hal_hwfactoryinterface_default hal_factoryinterface_client (binder (call transfer)))
(allow system_server_{{vers}} hal_hwfactoryinterface_hwservice (hwservice_manager (find)))

(allow hal_hwfactoryinterface_default system_server_{{vers}} (binder (call transfer)))
(allow cust_{{vers}} hal_hwfactoryinterface_hwservice (hwservice_manager (find)))

(allow hal_factoryinterface_client {{pick:hal_hwfactoryinterface_service}} (service_manager (find)))
(allow system_server_{{vers}} {{pick:hal_hwfactoryinterface_service}} (service_manager (find)))
(allow cust_{{vers}} {{pick:hal_hwfactoryinterface_service}} (service_manager (find)))
;; @when-file bin/hw/vendor.honor.hardware.hwfactoryinterface-service
